newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 13.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Writers and film producers protest law designed to control illegal immigration and notably the monitoring of the arrival and departure of foreign guests.
-- French firms no longer lack equity, but still show a low profitability, according to OECD report on France released today.
-- PSA carmaker is losing ground on the european market, registers a 12.3 percent plunge for January.
-- Lagardere group starts legal action at Council of State over aborted sale of Thomson SA to Lagardere in December following negative ruling by privatisation committee.
-- Generale des Eaux allies with railway operator SNCF in the telecommunications industry, competing with France Telecom.
